name: Brigade Valencia
description: A 24-acre Spanish-style community on Hosur Road near Electronic City, with about 85% of the land kept open and more than 35 amenities. The current phase, Brillio, offers 4 BHK apartments.
curation: Large 24-acre site with about 85% open space
Narayana Hrudayalaya and Mazumdar Shaw Medical Centre nearby
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
